source.title: 2027 State Calendar - State Holidays (Alaska Division of Finance, revised 09/29/2025); cross-checked with 2026 Holiday Schedule (doa.alaska.gov/dof/payroll/resource/hldy2026.pdf, by bargaining unit) and AS 44.12.010

stateHolidays.name: Seward's Day
stateHolidays.note: Last Monday of March; AS 44.12.010(a)(4). Mar 29, 2027; Mar 30, 2026.

stateHolidays.name: Alaska Day
stateHolidays.note: Oct 18, shifted for weekends (observed Mon Oct 19 in 2026 because Oct 18 was a Sunday; Mon Oct 18 in 2027); AS 44.12.010(a)(9).

partialOrLocal.name: Floating Holiday
partialOrLocal.note: Given to most general-government bargaining units (AA, AP, GP, GZ, KK, SS in the 2026 schedule); not all units.

partialOrLocal.name: Longevity Floating Holiday
partialOrLocal.note: 2026 schedule: only units GP, GZ, KK, SS. Not counted in floating_days.

partialOrLocal.name: Day After Thanksgiving
partialOrLocal.note: 2026 schedule: paid holiday ONLY for unit TM; 'No' for every other unit. Not a general state holiday.

partialOrLocal.name: Lincoln's Birthday
partialOrLocal.note: 2026 schedule: floating holiday for units GC, XJ, BB, CC; holiday for unit MM only; 'No' for all others.

partialOrLocal.name: Units TA and TM schedule differences
partialOrLocal.note: 2026 schedule: unit TA gets no MLK Day, Presidents' Day, Seward's Day, Juneteenth, Alaska Day or Veterans' Day; unit TM gets no MLK Day, Presidents' Day, Seward's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Alaska Day or Veterans' Day; unit CC gets no Juneteenth. State calendar tells employees to consult their bargaining-unit agreement.
